body: As I reach for the letter, I notice the familiar script, the strokes of which I've honed over years of practice. The ink flows effortlessly, as if the words themselves are begging to be set free. A hint of excitement bubbles up within me, and I can't help but lean in, the weight of the envelope almost palpable.
